fusions.name: Tongue Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps out a tongue that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and stuns it for 1 second. Its reach is 40% longer.

fusions.name: Slick Palm
fusions.desc: A bare-fisted strike that deals 7 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Marsh Wash
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and every ally within 5 tiles.

fusions.name: Pond Reflex
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You have 6% more dodge chance.
